summary: Labeled file upload, with an optional hint and error message.
use: Uploading a file, such as a photo or a document. Its form/form needs method post and enctype multipart/form-data.

name.description: The field's name in the submitted form data.

accept.description: The kind of file it takes; any kind when left out.

hint.description: Help shown with the field until it's valid.

error.description: Shown when the browser finds the value invalid.

obligations: The label names the file wanted.
